newsitem.title: USA: GM second quarter incentives rise.
newsitem.headline: GM second quarter incentives rise.

text.p: General Motors Corp on Wednesday reported average retail incentives for the second quarter at its North American Operations were $1,060, up from $695 a year ago.
Average incentives for GM Europe rose to $554 from $495 for the same period. GM reported earnings Wednsday of $2.1 billion or $2.68 a share, up from $1.9 billion or $2.63 a share.

GM said its European automotive operations had net income of $312 million, including a $103 million after-tax gain from the sale of its share in Avis Europe. That compares to net income of $319 million in the 1996 second quarter.
GM's combined U.S. car and truck market share was 30.5 percent in the second quarter, down from 32 percent a year ago. In Western Europe, GM's share rose to 11.5 percent from 11.1 percent.
